name: Supersonic Highway Defenders
detailed_description:
Supersonic Highway Defenders is a tactical vehicular combat roguelite where the road is your battlefield and survival is never guaranteed. In a world stuck in a 14-day reset loop, you command a convoy of heavily armed vehicles, battling factions, upgrading vehicles, and uncovering the truth behind the glitch that doomed reality. Can you break the loop before it breaks you?

DRIVE, FIGHT, REPEAT

Outrun death across an endless highway of chaos. Engage in explosive grid-based battles where every move counts. Dodge hazards, fire your weapons, ram your opponents, and then trigger high-tech cassette tapes loaded with deadly abilities.

BUILD YOUR CONVOY

Your vehicles are more than metal - they're survival. Customise each vehicle with modular upgrades, unique drivers, and tactical weapon layouts. Scavenge parts, swap gear mid-run, and evolve your convoy over time.

BREAK THE LOOP

Every 14 days, the world resets - but your memories don’t. Discover persistent upgrades, unlock characters, and collect relics of the past to carry power into the next cycle. The only way out... is through.

EXPLORE A GLITCHED WORLD

Navigate a fractured simulation where factions rule the roads and reality frays at the edges. Encounter glitchpunk hackers, cyber-noir femme fighters, AI worshipers, and wandering nomads - each with their own beliefs about the loop.

SURVIVE HIGHWAY HAZARDS

Between battles, manage your convoy in real time while the road keeps moving. Avoid rocket strikes, drone attacks, toxic zones, and tunnels shrouded in darkness. Tools like gas masks, welders, and jammers may be your only lifeline.

TACTICS MEET TREAD

  • Strategic, turn-based combat with high-speed flair

  • Deep convoy management and upgrade systems

  • Six factions, each with unique philosophy and playstyle

  • Hundreds of weapons, tapes, drivers, and vehicle builds

  • A glitched world where every loop is a second chance - or a final ride

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 or Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
